name: text-to-speech-application
description: Text-to-Speech Platform — React (Vite) frontend + Express backend, one command to run them all

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
